notes: There is plainly a space here — a small arcade room — but nobody walks it: the menu places the player in front of the pinball machine and the game is played through UI with the camera held off the cabinet, so stage B answers yes then no and appends SET. That makes set-display the shape, the case the catalogue names with this exact example: the machine is the subject and the room is its setting, framed to be looked at and operated from outside. Display Piece is the matching preset, with landmark-focal as the hero cabinet the whole set composes around and zone-graphics carrying the 'as realistic as possible' ask as a high-fidelity detail cluster; I dropped vignette-photo because a fixed camera on one machine has no screenshot spots to walk to. Deciding without a user, I built the additional cabinets as non-playable set dressing exactly as the answers scoped them, and named no second genre even though an arcade of several games would be a minigame collection — this build is one machine.
